svg.title: coalescing
svg.text: Coalescing on a toy: 8×8 matrix, a warp of 8 lanes, a transaction = 8 floats
the matrix lives in memory row after row: address = row · 8 + col
naive (lane → row): lane r reads A[r·8 + k]
coalesced (lane → column): lane c reads B[k·8 + c]
addresses k, 8+k, 16+k, …, 56+k: 8 lanes touch 8 different segments → 8 transactions per load
addresses 8k … 8k+7: one segment → 1 transaction per load (8× fewer)
animated: k steps 0 → 3; red = the naive warp's loads, green = the coalesced warp's. Real GPU: 32 lanes, 128-byte lines; measured 10.9×
